  "study": "L.-L.W. 2016",

  "experimental_arm": {
    "label": "LCD group",
    "intervention_description": "Low-carbohydrate diet (LCD) using the six-point formula; carbohydrate intake <45% of total calories, replaced by nuts; patients receive education and weekly follow-up",

    "hba1c_change_mean": "0.63",

  },
  "control_arm": {
    "label": "LFD group",
    "intervention_description": "Low-fat diet (LFD) using the six-point formula; fat intake <45% of total calories; patients receive education and weekly follow-up",
    "n_randomized": "28",
    "n_analyzed": "25",
    "hba1c_change_mean": "0.31",
